props.text: IAR Systems supplies future-proof software tools and services for embedded development, enabling companies worldwide to create the products of today and the innovations of tomorrow. Since 1983, IAR Systems' solutions have ensured quality, reliability and efficiency in the development of over one million embedded applications. The complete C/C++ compiler and debugger toolchain, IAR Embedded Workbench, offers full-scale support for Microchip's 8- and 32-bit AVR MCUs as well as Microchip's ARM-based and 8051-based MCUs families.

Stop by the TASKING booth to see demonstrations of our latest Safety Critical Debug and Test workflows for applications running on Microchip SAM V71 and PolarFire RISC-V devices.  The workflows include Static and Dynamic Analysis along with Timing and Coverage Analysis needed to satisfy up to DO-178C DAL-A or ISO 26262 ASIL-D requirements. You can also see a preview of our AI-assisted Solutions that can further accelerate software development and certification.
The PIC32CM-PL10 Curiosity Nano Evaluation Kit

Using                in 
Visual Sudio Code 
(VS Code)

This utility enables CMSIS-DAP on most Microchip programmers, debuggers, and evaluation boards, providing full support in CMSIS-DAP compliant environments such as VS Code®, IAR Embedded Workbench®, Keil®MDK,  Eclipse IDE, OpenOCD, and more.

The PIC32CM-PL10 family of microcontrollers is currently supported by CMSIS, with additional devices planned for future support. Get started developing with the PIC32CM-PL10 Curiosity Nano Evaluation Kit (EV10P22A).

props.text:
Microchip zSDK is a framework that delivers a minimally customized Zephyr® distribution, with downstream modules and Microchip libraries. This will enable embedded teams to build, flash and debug production-ready applications on Microchip microcontrollers from one trusted starting point.

zSDK uses the Zephyr west meta-tool to orchestrate a curated set of repositories, each pinned to a tested revision in a top-level manifest. One workspace — mchp_zephyrproject — assembles everything you need.
